scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Bring a hammer and a light.
scenes.body: Salt-belt trucks rot. Check the rails, crossmembers and rear link mounts.

scenes.title: A $2,000–4,000 surprise.
scenes.body: The secondary air pump can fail around 100–150k miles: check-engine light, limp mode.

scenes.title: Ask for the receipt.
scenes.body: The V8 has a belt (the V6 a chain), due at 90,000 miles or nine years.

scenes.title: 2003–05 head gaskets.
scenes.body: A cylinder 6 misfire (P0306) plus coolant loss is the red flag.

scenes.title: X-REAS and rear air.
scenes.body: Leaky X-REAS shocks get replaced in pairs. On Limiteds, check the rear doesn't sag overnight.

scenes.title: Plus a printable checklist.
scenes.body: Free at boxytrucks.com. Link in bio.
